changes.title: Frame garbage
items: Smoother late runs: far less memory churned each frame (fewer sudden hitches), work done ahead now leaves room for the drawing, and party decorations, berries and the forest's look-ahead skip what's out of view or already done

changes.title: Prop rocks
items: With ?props=gen, boulders and mounds come in many shapes too: grey, granite or sandstone boulders, cracked and mossy, and mounds of moss or bare earth

changes.title: Party guests
items: The party spreads out: happy creatures gather at the party's picnics, tables, balloons and lanterns, not only round the soundsystem
Each guest has its own dance (a bounce, a sway, a hop, a bob), and party animals tap their feet (and party shoes) on the beat
